title: Hontiveros: SC ruling voiding seafarers’ bond rule eases burden
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court’s decision to strike down provisions of the Magna Carta of Filipino Seafarers requiring seafarers to post bonds before receiving monetary awards is a win for…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Supreme Court’s decision to strike down provisions of the Magna Carta of Filipino Seafarers requiring seafarers to post bonds before receiving monetary awards is a win for seafarers, Sen. Risa Hontiveros said on Tuesday. “We welcome the Supreme Court’s decision declaring the bond requirement under the Magna Carta of Filipino Seafarers unconstitutional. Finally, the burden has been lifted,” she said READ: SC strikes down portions of Magna Carta of seafarers During the Senate debates on the Magna Carta, Hontiveros opposed the bond requirement. She maintained the same position when the measure was taken up by both chambers […]... Keep on reading: Hontiveros: SC ruling voiding seafarers’ bond rule eases burden
